speaker: Devotee (remembering)
question: Whom remember?
premises: To make hard easy, to gladden suffering likewise.
Sole-heroic is whose remembrance: him we remember, love's foe.
inference: Remember love's foe, whose remembrance conquers hardship.

speaker: Devotee (exulting songs)
question: Whose songs conquer?
premises: Victorious songs whose singable is the supreme lord.
By whose name even great souls are sown with thrill-sprouts.
inference: Songs of the supreme lord conquer, thrilling great souls.

option_choices.reason: Victory-exclamation (songs conquer); finite plural same victory, T1 kept.
Are-sown (thrill-sprouts sown); scattered same strewing, T1 sown kept.

speaker: Devotee (supposing identity)
question: What if you were indeed you?
premises: As you, indeed you would be, if supreme — O Bhava.
Whose three-world-beginning-dissolution is arrayed by own power formations.
inference: If supreme, you are arrayed beginning-dissolution by own power.

option_choices.reason: Supreme (if supreme you); further same para, T1 supreme kept.

speaker: Devotee (begging mantra)
question: What mantra that I be yours?
premises: Mantra you are, counsel-worthy you are, counsellor — whence another than you?
He — to me give that mantra, so that I may be your mantra, O lord.
inference: You are mantra and counsellor; give that mantra making me yours.

option_choices.reason: Counsel-worthy (fit to advise); to-be-consulted same mantraṇīya, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (puzzling identity)
question: How dream in you?
premises: Light-formed, true-resolve, you are the self of whom — even he am I.
'Transmigrator' thus — what, O lord, is this — that dream even, whence in you?
inference: You are self of whom I am; yet transmigrator-dream — whence?
uncertainties: Highly compressed identity wordplay (yasya…saḥ…aham; saṃsārī iti; svapnaḥ) — literal only, needs Kṣemarāja at L0/argmap.

speaker: Devotee (naming lordship)
question: Whose is unbroken coherent lordship?
premises: That unbroken, that unvulgar, that one, coherent.
In you, O lord, is the lordship of those who entrust work-fruits.
inference: Unbroken coherent lordship is in you, of fruit-entrusters.

option_choices.reason: Unvulgar (refined, not crude); not-rustic same a-grāmya, T1 kept.
Coherent (hanging together); possessing-proof same upapatti, T1 kept.

speaker: Devotee (praising capable beloved)
question: What can he not destroy or give?
premises: Capable — what misfortune not to destroy, what fortune not to give, or.
Who is that-one: he is our beloved, god of gods, bull-bannered.
inference: Our beloved bull-bannered can destroy all ills, give all fortunes.

speaker: Devotee (applying ointment)
question: What purifies the knowledge-eye?
premises: For the divine knowledge-eye blinded by māyā-made stain.
In purifying, O lord, devotion to you is the supreme ointment.
inference: Devotion to you is supreme ointment purifying the blinded eye.

speaker: Devotee (begging state)
question: Why wait to give the state?
premises: Fearless, bliss-constituted, one, imperishable — give the state, come to me, O god.
Quickly — why wait for that?
inference: Give the fearless bliss-state quickly; why wait?

option_choices.reason: State (pada as condition to give); place/foot same pada, T1 state kept.

speaker: Devotee (marveling ocean and crosser)
question: What ocean, what crosser?
premises: Ah, naturally deep, dreadful is the transmigration-ocean.
Ah, the means to cross it — the supreme someone — great lord.
inference: Dreadful ocean; supreme someone great lord crosses it.

option_choices.reason: Supreme (para as highest someone); other same para, T1 supreme kept.
